title: Western Massachusetts Electric Company requests approval of a special contract with Trew Corporation.
filings: The Department is concerned that the proposed arrangement violate G.L. c. 164 § 1C. Because of this concern, and because of the lack of evidence of an economic alternative to Trew purchasing its total electric service from WMECO, the Department cannot approve the contract. Signed by: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; John D. Patrone, Commissioner, James Connelly, Commissioner, W. Robert Keating, Commissioner and Paul B. Vasington, Commissioner.
